summary: StoneBridge Acquisition II Corporation filed a Form 8-K on September 21, 2026, furnishing its PFIC Annual Information Statement for the taxable year ended December 31, 2025, to holders of its Class A ordinary shares. The statement enables shareholders to consider a qualified electing fund election under Section 1295 of the Internal Revenue Code; the company disclaims any admission or representation as to PFIC status. This is a routine tax-information disclosure for a Nasdaq-listed SPAC, not a transaction. No special-situation event, terms, or risk-arb angle arises.
